def factor_corr_range_conditional(df):
    """Range-conditional price-volume correlation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    log_vol_chg = np.log1p(df_copy["volume"]).pct_change()
    corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=5).corr(log_vol_chg)
    corr = corr.fillna(0.0)
    range_ratio = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"]
    range_ratio = range_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    range_weight = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.tanh(range_ratio * 20.0)
    factor = corr * range_weight
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    factor.name = "factor_corr_range_conditional"
    return factor
description: Preserves parent1's rolling price-volume correlation as the primary mechanism, maintaining its rank stability and payoff monotonicity. Borrows parent2's bounded tanh normalized-range scaling as a lightweight regime modifier: price-volume correlation is amplified when intraday range is wide (information-intensive days) and attenuated when range is narrow, adding nonlinear responsiveness. This targets improved MI and ICIR while preserving RankIC/RankICIR strength.
